subject.statement: Elizabeth Holmes is currently in federal prison.

summary: Elizabeth Holmes was sentenced to 11 years and 3 months in federal prison in November 2022 and began serving her sentence in May 2023 at FPC Bryan, Texas. As of February 2026, she remains incarcerated with no credible reports of early release.
